value.answer: Microsoft is integrating GitHub Copilot with agentic AI features in Microsoft Teams, as part of its broader strategy to combine Copilot’s chat, coding, and agentic capabilities into a single "super app." This integration aims to enhance collaborative work by allowing users to engage with AI agents directly within Teams, leveraging GitHub Copilot’s coding assistance alongside other agentic functionalities.
